author: The Linux Foundation
description:
Sponsored by Harness

AI coding assistants are fundamentally changing how software gets built.

Developers can now generate applications, dependencies, infrastructure definitions, and deployment configurations faster than ever before. But while development velocity has accelerated dramatically, governance models still rely on manual reviews, disconnected tooling, and trust assumptions that no longer scale.

The result: organizations are deploying more software than ever — with less visibility into what’s actually moving through their delivery pipelines.

In this session, we’ll explore how AI-generated code is reshaping software supply chain risk, why traditional security approaches are struggling to keep pace, and what modern artifact governance should look like in high-velocity engineering environments.

title: LF Live Webinar: AI Writes Code Fast. Can You Trust What Gets Deployed?
